# About This Script

In this script we will build the figures and tables associate with Appendix S9 - A note on multiple sources of noise and sampling-related issues regarding functional diversity and composition metrics in our study.

We elaborate a custom function (`ses_hurry`) to compute the loss in terms of sites, species and mpd.

# Packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(reshape2)
# install.packages("scatterpie")
library(scatterpie)
library(here)

# This is a custom function for calculate the parameters 
# when removing n sites.
source(here("func/ses_hurry.R"))
```

# Load data

```{r}
d <- read_xlsx(here("data/data_ferns.xlsx"), sheet = "w_matrix")
e <- read_xlsx(here("data/data_ferns.xlsx"), sheet = "e_matrix")
org <- readRDS(here('data/org_data.RDS'))
```

# Reshaping data and measuring richness alongside the number of rare species

```{r}
mat <- acast(d, site ~ taxa, value.var = "FA_New", length)

freq <- colSums(mat)

q <- quantile(freq, probs = c(0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE)

class <- cut(
  freq,
  breaks = c(-Inf, q[1], q[2], Inf),
  labels = c("rare", "common", "frequent")
)

rare <- mat[, class == "rare"] %>% rowSums()
common <- mat[, class == "common"] %>% rowSums()
frequent <- mat[, class == "frequent"] %>% rowSums()

mat2 <- acast(d, site ~ taxa, value.var = "FA_New", length)

df <- cbind.data.frame(
  Rare = rare,
  Richness = rowSums(mat),
  Samp_size = logb(e$samp_size, base = 1.3),
  Plot_size = logb(e$plot_size, base = 1.3)
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Site") %>%
  mutate(Common = Richness - Rare)

```
# Evaluating the Kendall correlation with sample characteristics

We have transformed data in log base 1.3 due a limitation of `scattepie` package. Now we use the raw number for evaluate Kendall correlation.

```{r}
cor.test(df$Richness, 1.3^df$Samp_size, method = "kendall")
cor.test(df$Rare, 1.3^df$Samp_size, method = "kendall")
cor.test(df$Richness, 1.3^df$Plot_size, method = "kendall")
cor.test(df$Rare, 1.3^df$Plot_size, method = "kendall")

```
# Plotting rare species and richness relationship with sample characteristics

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_scatterpie(
    data = df,
    aes(
      x = Samp_size,
      y = Richness,
      r = 0.7
    ),
    cols = c("Rare", "Common"),
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.7,
    pie_scale = .5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Rare" = "#d73027", "Common" = "grey70"),
    name = "Species"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Sampling effort (log1.3)"),
    y = "Species richness",
    caption = "Total richness: τ = 0.14; p-value = 0.31\n
                Rare species richness: τ = 0.20; p-value = 0.18"
  )


ggsave(
  "figs/Major_2/Appendix_rare.tiff",
  dpi = 300,
  width = 180,
  height = 120,
  units = "mm"
)


ggplot() +
  geom_scatterpie(
    data = df,
    aes(
      x = Plot_size,
      y = Richness,
      r = 0.6
    ),
    cols = c("Rare", "Common"),
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.7,
    pie_scale = .1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Rare" = "darkgreen", "Common" = "grey70"),
    name = "Species"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Sampling effort (log1.3)"),
    y = "Species richness",
    caption = "Total richness: τ = -0.09; p-value = 0.56\n
                Rare species richness: τ = -0.12; p-value = 0.45"
  )

ggsave(
here("figs/Major_2/Appendix_rare_plot.tiff"),
  dpi = 300,
  width = 180,
  height = 120,
  units = "mm"
)

```

# Elaborating table of Appendix S9

```{r}
ses_25 <- ses_hurry(data = org, strata = .19, complete = F)

ses_55 <- ses_hurry(data = org, strata = .39, complete = F)

ses_75 <- ses_hurry(data = org, strata = .59, complete = F)

ses_full <- ses_hurry(data = org, strata = 0)

shapiro.test(ses_full$Data_AB$ntaxa)
shapiro.test(ses_full$Data_AB$plot_size)

cor.test(ses_full$Data_AB$ntaxa, ses_full$Data_AB$samp_size, method = "kendall")
cor.test(ses_full$Data_AB$ntaxa, ses_full$Data_AB$plot_size, method = "kendall")



resume <- rbind(
  ses_full$Parameters,
  ses_25$Parameters,
  ses_55$Parameters,
  ses_75$Parameters
)

rownames(resume) <- c("All sizes", "<250", "<550", "<750")
res <- t(round(resume, 3))

write.csv(res, file = here( "outputs/Changes in taxonomic parameter.csv"))

```
